huggingface.summary: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. huggingface.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents

huggingface.title: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
huggingface.summary: Recent work suggests that pretrained image generators encode real-world understanding beyond image synthesis. Vision Banana exploits this by framing vision tasks as conditional image editing. However, its data, weights, code, and implementation details are not public.
